svg.text: The analyst states the scenario in one sentence, the evidence tier,

text.font-family: Calibri, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and the proposed priority. No debate yet. Everyone reads the draft.

svg.text: Analyze the attack path as a team

text.font-family: Calibri, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Is this how the chain actually runs? Is a step missing, or are two

text.font-family: Calibri, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: steps really one? Did any control hold? Record what held.

text.font-family: Calibri, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Calibri, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Does anything alert on it, or is it only logged?

svg.text: Every Blind and Collectable row gets an owner and a ticket number,

text.font-family: Calibri, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: typed into the record while everyone is still in the room.

svg.text: The team analyzes each step together and records what it finds. Disagreement is a finding, not a fight: write it into the record.

svg.text: The measure of this work is not how many scenarios exist. It is how many rows move from Blind to Have, with evidence behind them and a ticket that closed.
